Player: hi
Fernlor: I am the High Scryer of the Arcane Academy. I need your help on a mission to investigate an anomaly that I discovered.
Player: mission
Fernlor: As far as the people here are concerned you are some kind of hero. And even better, you often work for free! Which, I must say, really helps, given the limited resources allocated to my operation. ...
Fernlor: I need someone with your skill set to find out what's going on there. Are you up to it? Yes or no?
Player: Yes
Fernlor: Excellent! My first probes suggest you probably won't die by environmental hazards on arrival. ...
Fernlor: To summarize things: I found a recent disturbance at some remote, uncharted isle in the east. I established a teleport connection to that place. ...
Fernlor: I am a researcher, not an explorer though so it needs someone with your unique and proven talent to find out what's going on there. Take the teleporter over there!

Fernlor
